prompt: Match each schedule type to how it triggers.

pairs.right: Clock-based: every set period, with an optional offset from midnight
Whenever the chosen input attributes receive new values
The scheduled time, or the triggering input event's time

explanation: Periodic scheduling is clock-based; event-triggered scheduling runs when inputs get new values (Any Input or a chosen list).

prompt: For an event-triggered analysis, what is the trigger time?
explanation: The trigger time is the scheduled time for periodic analyses and the input's event time for event-triggered analyses. By default it is also the output timestamp.

prompt: Which are advanced output timestamp options for an analysis? Select all that apply.
explanation: The options are Trigger Time (default), Execution Time and Relative to Trigger Time, which allows future-stamped outputs.

prompt: True or false: you can backfill an analysis whose outputs are not mapped to PI Points.
explanation: False. "Backfilling/recalculation requires that the output attributes have been mapped to PI Points."

prompt: Match each backfill option to its effect.

pairs.left: Leave existing data and fill gaps
pairs.right: Keeps existing results and only fills missing periods

pairs.left: Permanently delete existing data and recalculate
pairs.right: Removes existing results and computes them again

explanation: The first two are the backfill/recalculation modes; auto-backfilling fills gaps between service restarts. Use the delete-and-recalculate mode when existing results are wrong.

prompt: Order the steps to backfill analyses in bulk in PSE.

items.text: Open Management and run an Analysis Search with criteria (for example Template)
Set the start (for example *-1w) and choose the mode
Queue and watch the Backfilling column

explanation: The PI World 2019 lab procedure: Management > Analysis Searches > Add Criteria > select analyses > Operations > Backfill/Recalculate > Start > mode > Queue. Progress shows in the Backfilling column.

prompt: Why might the rollup still be wrong?
scenario: An engineer recalculates one turbine's efficiency analysis from that element's Analyses tab. The Farm rollup that depends on it still shows the old values.

options.text: Requests from a single element's Analyses tab ignore dependent analyses unless the dependent-analyses recalculation option is selected
The Farm template is checked out

explanation: Requests from the Management plug-in account for dependencies; requests from a single element's Analyses tab ignore them unless you select the option to recalculate dependent analyses.

prompt: An event-triggered analysis has six fast-changing inputs and uses the default 'Any Input'. What is the risk?

options.text: It can trigger several times per second

explanation: Defaulting to Any Input can trigger an analysis several times per second when it has several inputs. List only the inputs that should trigger, or use a periodic schedule.

prompt: TriggerRatio = AverageElapsed / AverageTrigger. AVEVA says it should ideally be below which value?
explanation: Ideally TriggerRatio is below 0.15; about 2.5 means the group will lag perpetually, because evaluations take longer than the time between triggers.

prompt: What is the healthy value for the Evaluation Skipped Count counter?
explanation: Evaluation Skipped Count should stay at 0. A steadily rising value means the service cannot keep up and is dropping evaluations.

prompt: Which change follows AVEVA's performance advice?
scenario: An analysis computes TagAvg('Temperature','*-30d','*') and is event-triggered on a 1-second input. Latency is climbing.

options.text: Change it to an hourly periodic schedule (or use shorter windows or daily-to-monthly rollups)
Add more inputs to Any Input
Switch to an Analysis data reference

explanation: Expensive summaries over long ranges evaluated often should use a less frequent schedule, a shorter window or rollups. A performance lab moved an event-scheduled 30-day average to hourly periodic scheduling.

prompt: Late data is causing recalculation cascades. AVEVA's suggested mitigation is to disable automatic recalculation and recalculate manually at low-load times. Which time is specifically called out as a bad choice?
explanation: The 2020 lab says to avoid midnight, because many daily calculations already run then.

prompt: In the AF SDK, the periodic time rule's ConfigString for a 5-minute period is Frequency=____. Type the full ConfigString.
explanation: The periodic time rule plug-in is Periodic, with ConfigString Frequency in seconds, so 5 minutes is Frequency=300.
